name: brine_to_water_heat_pump_refsim
title: Brine-to-water heat pump reference model (RefSim)
summary: Reference simulation model of a brine-to-water (ground-source) heat pump of the ULiège model bank: a scroll compressor described in five steps (suction heating-up, isentropic compression to an adapted pressure, isochoric compression to the discharge plenum, exhaust cooling-down and internal leakage through the scroll throat) with all its heat transfers referred to a fictitious envelope of uniform temperature, a brine evaporator and a water condenser, both described by three thermal resistances in series referred to their nominal flows; the brine properties come from the BrineProp library.
language_features: user-library procedure BRINEPROP (implicit library, copied in the file)
IF/THEN/ELSE ladders closed by ENDIF;ENDIF groups
LOOKUP$ (unit labels in a lookup table)
lookup tables read inside a procedure

origin.course: ULiège model bank (Laborelec toolkit lineage), heat production by vapour compression, reference simulation model, 8 January 2008

verification.summary: Adapted model (P_ev, P_cd, M_dot_r unknowns as in the original; internal power on the swept flow, closing a 124 W compressor energy-balance gap) vs the EES 7.888 stored solution: COP 4.021 vs 4.112, W 3984 vs 3760 W, Q_cd 16017 vs 15463 W. Rest of the gap: EES 7.888 R407C (suction cp -10 %) vs two CoolProp formulations that agree. Balances closed.
verification.reference: EES stored solution of BrinetoWaterHeatPump_RefSim_EES_Model_VL080108.EES (142 of 146 records); R407C cross-check: CoolProp pseudo-pure R407C vs HEOS mixture R32[0.3811]&R125[0.1796]&R134a[0.4393] in CoolSolve
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 142 common, 95 differ at rtol 1e-3 (absolute R407C h/s offsets +143.4 kJ/kg, +763 J/kg-K included). Without the power correction the same model is within 0.3-3.8 % of EES (COP 4.1815, W 3827 W): the correction adds 124 W internal / 155 W electrical power. R407C: suction cp 833.7 (EES) vs 930.8 (CoolProp pseudo-pure) / 929.3 (CoolProp mixture model); dew T at 436.2 kPa -1.248 vs -1.554 / -1.554 C. Energy balances of the .sol: compressor W = M_dot_r*(h_ex-h_su) + Q_amb to round-off, envelope, water, brine. Converges from the shipped .initials; from the EES stored values only Try Harder (96 it.); from default guesses SingularJacobian even with Try Harder. The _coolsolve variant (EES operating point, closures as checks) was removed.

related_external: BrineProp library of the ULiège model bank (Brineprop.lib, Brine1.lkt, Brine2.lkt; inventory candidate TM-0479)
